acceptance.A1: all four pilot controls behave as specified
acceptance.A2: at least 200 of 256 subset variants carry a finite score and both measured outcomes
acceptance.A3: all six reference checks pass inside the run
acceptance.A4: point estimates and bootstrap intervals exist for rho_surface, rho_function and delta_rho
acceptance.A5: combined wall clock at most 60 minutes

analysis.pairing: the same resampled variant indices are used for both assays

data.license: MIT (ProteinGym curation); measurements belong to the source publication

external_reference.note: read from ProteinGym's published table over the FULL datasets with their own pipeline; a lead, not a verified input, and not reproduced here

falsifier.falsified_if: 95% CI for delta_rho lies entirely at or below 0
falsifier.hypothesis: ESM-2 masked-marginal ranking agrees better with Kir2.1 surface expression than with channel function on matched variants
falsifier.supported_if: 95% CI for delta_rho lies entirely above 0
falsifier.undetermined_if: CI spans 0; reported as undetermined, never as support

leakage_rules: model frozen and zero-shot; nothing trained, fitted or calibrated
scorer API cannot accept an assay value
subset selected by hash of the variant name alone
no threshold, weight or model choice depends on a measured outcome
analysis runs once; every run is reported if repeated

model.operation: masked_marginal = log p(mut | x_masked at i) - log p(wt | x_masked at i)
model.step_down_rule: if projected scoring time exceeds 25 minutes, step down and record which checkpoint produced the numbers; depends only on wall-clock latency

pilot.N1: declared wild-type residue wrong for the position -> must raise ReferenceMismatch
pilot.P2: a real matched variant -> finite score and reconstructed sequence equals the CSV mutated_sequence

resource_limits.raw_gpu: none submitted from this harness; a GPU need would be requested from dx-gpuops-r1 by file and the protocol amended first

subset.rule: first 256 matched variants sorted by (sha256(f'{salt}|{mutant}').hexdigest(), mutant)
